password.description: Password for the OpenStack user. Securely managed in production (e.g., via vault).

region_name.description: Region to use for Ironic API calls (optional).

cafile.description: Path to CA bundle for TLS verification (empty = system defaults).

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (insecure — only for testing).

node_id.description: Ironic node UUID to fence. Required if node_name is not provided.

node_name.description: Ironic node name to fence. Ignored if node_id is set.

retry.description: Number of times to retry the fencing operation.

login_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for authentication (login) to complete.

command_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a fencing command (e.g., node state change) to complete.

domain_name.description: Keystone domain name (for v3 auth with domains).

project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name (for v3 auth).
